spans.s: मौषल [mauṣala], a. A bath in which one remains steady like a pestle in water.
Relating to the battle with clubs (as a parvan; in this parvan (

th) is narrated the death of Kṛiṣṇa and Balarāma, and the self-destruction of Kṛiṣṇa's family through the curse of Brāhmaṇas).-लः A kind of madhuparka. -लम् The destruction of Yādavas in the battle with clubs; वज्रस्तस्याभवद्यस्तु मौसलादवशेषितः
मौष्टा [mauṣṭā], Playing at fisticuffs, a boxing or pugilistic encounter.
